meta.name: security-audit
meta.description: Deep security audit covering OWASP Top 10, authentication, authorization, data protection, dependency vulnerabilities, and secrets scanning. Delegates to the Centinela (QA) agent.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫描代码中的安全漏洞与配置风险
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在发布前发现并修复安全漏洞。
copy.tagline_en: Scan code for security vulnerabilities and configuration risks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to find and fix security vulnerabilities before release.

howto.what: Claude 执行深度安全审计：按 OWASP Top 10 检查，扫描硬编码密钥和连接字符串，审计依赖漏洞，有 Solidity 则检查智能合约。完成后在 docs/reviews/ 生成报告，给出 APPROVED 或 CHANGES REQUIRED，并整理修复建议交给开发方。只记录问题，不直接修复。
howto.when: 当用户输入 /security-audit 命令时触发，常用于发布前、重大代码改动后、添加新依赖等时机。

say.note: 审计整个 src/ 目录并生成报告
仅审计这两个指定目录
专门审计支付相关代码

howto.what_en: Claude performs a deep security audit (OWASP Top 10, secrets, dependencies, smart contracts if Solidity). Writes report to docs/reviews/, gives APPROVED or CHANGES REQUIRED, and prepares findings for Dev agent. Only documents, never fixes.
howto.when_en: Triggered by the /security-audit command. Use before releases, after major code changes, or when adding new dependencies.

say_en.note: Audits the whole src/ directory and writes a report.
